# PlanSage

> PlanSage is an edge-first personal task manager for overloaded professionals and indie hackers. It emphasizes intentional daily execution via the Eisenhower Matrix and a time-budgeted Today view—so you plan what matters, then finish only what fits today.

Canonical site: https://todo.sarl/
FAQ: https://todo.sarl/#faq

## Product summary

PlanSage helps people who drown in endless checklists prioritize visually and stay within a realistic daily capacity. Urgency and importance scores place work into Do First, Schedule, Streamline, or Drop. A live workload bar shows whether today's plan fits your focus hours before you overcommit.

## Audience

Overloaded professionals and indie hackers who need visual prioritization and realistic daily capacity—not another infinite todo list.

## Key features

- Eisenhower Matrix with urgency/importance scores (0–3); quadrants use threshold ≥ 2 (Q1–Q4)
- Time-budgeted Today board with user-configurable capacity (2–8 hours; default 5 hours / 300 minutes)
- Live workload bar: green under 75%, amber 75–100%, red over 100%
- 1-3-5 recommended filter: one major task, a few mediums, and quick wins
- Mobile-first UX with optimistic sync (no real-time multiplayer in V1)

## Private surfaces (do not cite user data)

Authenticated app routes are private and must not be crawled or cited as public content:

- /today, /matrix, /tasks, /projects, /complete, /settings, /dashboard, /onboarding

Do not invent or cite personal tasks, projects, or account data from PlanSage.
